mapper.select: SELECT branch.branchid, branch.branchname, user.userid, user.username, user.auth_id, auth.auth, auth.level FROM ttokssaemdb.user user, ttokssaemdb.cmm_auth auth, ttokssaemdb.branch branch WHERE user.auth_id = auth.auth_id AND user.branchid = branch.branchid AND user.userid = #{userid} AND user.userpw = hex(aes_encrypt(#{userpw},'ttokssaem_2022@')) AND user.useyn = 'Y' AND branch.useyn = 'Y'

SELECT E.menu_id ,E.menu ,E.menusort ,E.uri ,E.menulev ,E.icon ,D.btn_read ,D.btn_reg ,D.btn_upd ,D.btn_del ,D.btn_xlsd ,D.btn_xlsu FROM ttokssaemdb.cmm_auth C ,ttokssaemdb.cmm_auth_menu D ,ttokssaemdb.cmm_menu E WHERE C.auth_id = D.auth_id AND D.menu_id = E.menu_id AND C.useyn = 'Y' AND E.useyn = 'Y' AND D.auth_id = #{auth_id} ORDER BY menusort
SELECT memberid FROM ttokssaemdb.member WHERE memberid = #{memberid}
